tool.choose_support: Picked a reviewed explanation for you
tool.get_model_sources: Read what a learning preference is based on
tool.list_generation_profiles: Looked at how new teaching may be written
tool.check_teaching: Checked a draft against the course
tool.request_research: Asked to look for public sources
status.researchCollected: Found public sources. They need a review before you see them.
status.researchQueued: Looking for public sources. They need a review before you see them.
status.researchRefused: Couldn't look for sources, so nothing was collected.
status.researchCancelled: Stopped looking for sources. Nothing will be collected.
status.researchNotSent: Didn't look for sources, so nothing was collected.
status.researchStaged: Getting ready to look for sources. This needs a review first.
status.checkPassedNotDelivered: The draft passed the course's checks but wasn't added.
status.checkPassed: The draft passed the course's checks. It still needs a final review.
status.checkRejected: The draft didn't pass the course's checks, so it needs revising.
status.checkUnavailable: Couldn't check the draft, so it wasn't used.
status.notSelected: Another option was picked for your lesson.
status.suggestionReady: Ready for your review in Learning memory.
status.suggestionAccepted: You accepted it. It doesn't count toward your progress.
status.suggestionCorrected: You corrected it. It doesn't count toward your progress.
status.suggestionDisputed: You disputed it, so your companion doesn't use it.
status.suggestionPending: Suggested. It's checked before you see it.
status.permissionOff: No change: personal support is off.
status.noSupport: No reviewed explanation fits yet, so nothing changed.
status.toolLimit: Too much to read at once, so nothing changed.
status.selectedPending: Picked. It's checked before it's added.
error.unavailable: Couldn't load this. Refresh to try again.
notice.off: Personal lesson support is off. What was already added stays in your record.
error.savedRefresh: Your choice was saved. Refresh your course to see its current progress.
error.unconfirmed: Your choice isn't confirmed yet. Try the same choice again before making a different one.
error.notSaved: Your choice couldn't be saved. Refresh and try again.
settings.title: Personal lesson support
timeline.title: What your companion did
settings.body: While this is on, your companion can add reviewed explanations and practice for you, within your course's limits. You can turn it off at any time.
timeline.body: A record of what your companion read and did for you. It's optional to look at.
lockedByStudy: Your version of the course in the study has no personal support. Leave the study to turn it on.
tool.list_visuals: Looked at the course's pictures and animations
tool.choose_visual: Picked a course picture to show you
tool.request_authority: Asked for a decision it can't make alone
status.waitingForSafePoint: Ready, and waiting until you finish your current question. You can add it from the lesson.
status.learnerDeclined: You turned this down, so it wasn't added.
status.lapsed: No longer available, so it wasn't added.
share.on: While it's on, your companion also sees your open ideas.
share.detail: That includes ideas you wrote and your corrections. Ideas you reject or that lapse aren't shared, nothing from other learners is included, and your checks and what finishing the course needs stay the same.
share.whenOff: Even while it's off, your companion may review your answers, results and saved questions, within the AI spending limits your course team set, to prepare suggestions for them. It can't change your lessons while it's off.
